name: carpenter's goods

product.purpose: Prepare Etsy and Shopify product drafts and track agreed commissions from owner-exported sales.
product.publication: Manual publication only after owner approval; no platform write connector is used.
product.billing: Commission per sale, with the rate agreed in writing with the carpenter.

your_steps.title: Agree, sign, and provide the source files
your_steps.when: One working session with the carpenter, before preparing listings or calculating commission
your_steps.detail: Follow OWNER-STEPS.md step 1 and OWNER-DATA-REQUEST.md. Fill the prepared commission agreement together, resolve every marked term, and both sign it yourselves. Provide maker-confirmed product facts, original local photo paths, three current source-linked completed sales, and (if calculating earned commission) the official Etsy/Shopify order CSVs plus matching signed terms. The CLI supports legacy paid-sales.json input, but test fixtures are synthetic and must not be used as merchant data. Before the first physical-goods sale, check the linked Georgia DOR guidance to see whether registration applies; applicability is uncertain and Glacier makes no legal determination. Glacier does not sign, connect to either shop, or access accounts.

your_steps.title: Review the prepared drafts and publish only if approved
your_steps.when: After Glacier prepares the local drafts
your_steps.detail: Follow OWNER-STEPS.md step 2. Check every maker-confirmed fact and original photo, review the three-source comparable median, choose the final price yourself, then manually publish the Etsy listing only if approved. For Shopify, save as Draft first; change to Active and save only when you approve publication. Any commission report has a separate owner verification prompt: compare it to the signed terms and platform settlements before any payment. Glacier does not create accounts, publish, invoice, send messages, charge, or transfer money.

launch_gates: Owner agrees commission terms in writing with the carpenter.
Owner approves the first product listing before manual publication.
Any paid production or order is approved by the owner.
